Vision
To lead in veterinary clinical medicine through collaborative research, innovative teaching, and field application, providing top-tier clinical services and education to undergraduate and postgraduate students, veterinarians, para-vets, and animal owners. We aim to deliver veterinary care to large and small animals, foster highly skilled veterinarians in theriogenology, surgery and medicine, and extend clinical and educational support to the farming community, contributing to the advancement of veterinary practices regionally and nationally.”
M
i
ssion
“Our mission is to deliver innovative, world-class veterinary education, clinical care, and research. We aim to advance the field of veterinary surgery, theriogenology and clinical medicine by providing state-of-the-art diagnostic, surgical, and reproductive services. We are committed to training the next generation of veterinary professionals and scientists through hands-on learning and cutting-edge research. By establishing outreach centers and laboratories, we extend our research outcomes and clinical services to underserved farmers, veterinarians, and para-vets, contributing to improved animal health and welfare across the region.
Future Plans
Development of Advanced Diagnostic Facilities
We plan to establish a state-of-the-art molecular diagnostic laboratory for infectious diseases, which will enhance our capacity to provide accurate and timely diagnoses, benefiting both the veterinary field and animal owners.
Expansion of Research and Outreach Programs
Our department is committed to conducting field-based research with a focus on addressing the needs of small-scale farmers. We aim to extend research findings directly to end-users, including farmers, veterinarians, and para-vets, through our outreach and extension programs.
3
.·
Enhancement of Surgical Care and Training
Our goal is to provide the best possible care to animals requiring surgical services by integrating cutting-edge techniques, minimally invasive procedures, and state-of-the-art technology. Additionally, we aim to expand our educational programs in veterinary surgery and related fields, training the next generation of veterinary surgeons and health professionals.
4
.
Development of Reproductive and Embryology Services
We plan to establish a modern embryology laboratory and offer advanced reproductive diagnostic and treatment services, including semen testing. This initiative will enhance the department’s capacity to address reproductive health issues in animals and provide specialized care in theriogenology.
5
.
Commitment to Translational Research
Our future research programs will focus on producing new knowledge that contributes to practical veterinary solutions. By conducting problem-oriented research and translating findings into practical applications, we will continue to push the boundaries of veterinary clinical practice.
24/7 Clinical and Extension Services
We aim to provide round-the-clock clinical and extension services to ensure that farmers and animal owners have access to veterinary care when needed, improving overall animal health and productivity across the region.

Me
ssage of the Head of Department of Clinical Studies
It is with great pleasure and enthusiasm that we embark on a new and exciting chapter in the journey of academic excellence at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan.
I am honored to serve as the inaugural Chairman of the newly established Department of Clinical Studies, encompassing the vital fields of Veterinary Medicine, Animal Reproduction, and Veterinary Surgery within the College of Veterinary Sciences and Animal Husbandry. This Department represents a significant milestone in our commitment to providing cutting-edge education, fostering research, and promoting the highest standards of Veterinary care.
Our vision is to cultivate a dynamic learning environment where students are not only equipped with the latest knowledge and skills but are also inspired to push the boundaries of innovation in the realms of Veterinary Medicine, Animal Reproduction, and Veterinary Surgery Through a comprehensive curriculum, state-of-the-art facilities, and a team of dedicated faculty members, we aim to nurture the next generation of veterinary professionals who will contribute meaningfully to the well-being of animals and society.
Whether you are a prospective student, a member of the veterinary community or someone passionate about the welfare of animals, we invite you to explore the opportunities that our department has to offer. From innovative research projects to hands-on clinical experiences, we aim to provide a comprehensive and enriching educational journey.
As we lay the foundation for excellence in veterinary sciences, we welcome collaboration, partnerships, and engagement from the wider community. Your support and involvement are integral to our success, and together, we can make a lasting impact on the health and welfare of animals.
Dr. Naimat Ullah Khan
Associate Professor
Clinical Medicine Head of Department of Clinical Studies
